plan: reports/research/intel/I-20260923-08-free-data-substitutes.md sections 4 and 10 (SEC XBRL as-first-reported fundamentals, recommended first ingest); built by scripts/build_sec_xbrl_fundamentals.py
tool: open_composer/research/signal_card.py (rank: top 3000 PIT universe, top-30 long-only books; event: calendar-time books); source data/features/sec_fundamentals_daily

trials.note: screening; admission is not a strategy claim

admission_rule.rank: stable_years AND beats_shuffle AND (T1 or T2 top-30 book positive excess at 20 bp in both the full and the 2024+ window at the primary horizon) AND max |t_nonoverlap| over horizons >= 2.5 with the preregistered sign
admission_rule.event_long: beats_redated AND t_dates >= 3 at the primary horizon AND calendar-time book positive excess at 20 bp in the full and the 2024+ window
admission_rule.event_exit: t_dates <= -3 at the primary horizon AND beats_redated: admitted as an exit or avoid signal only

signals.name: pead_sue_eps_event
signals.rationale: Post-earnings-announcement drift on standardized unexpected earnings (Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 seasonal random walk; Bernard-Thomas 1989/1990 drift), event = sue_eps >= 2.0 (a fixed, preregistered ~2-sigma positive-surprise cutoff on the seasonal-random-walk statistic, not fitted to this sample) at the report's own usable session. Horizon 20 is primary; 60 is also reported by the tool's standard horizon set. recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: sue_eps_rank_recent
signals.rationale: Cross-sectional rank of standardized unexpected earnings (Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984), restricted to stocks within 5 sessions of their own usable report so the ranking is always freshly informed rather than stale across a whole quarter; direction +1 (higher surprise, higher expected return, Bernard-Thomas drift). recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: sue_rev_rank_recent
signals.rationale: Cross-sectional rank of standardized unexpected revenue, identical construction to sue_eps (Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 seasonal random walk) applied to revenue instead of EPS, same days_since_report <= 5 freshness restriction; direction +1. recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: gross_profitability
signals.rationale: Gross profit / total assets (Novy-Marx 2013, 'the other side of value'); numerator is the latest 10-K trailing-annual gross profit, denominator the latest known total assets; direction +1 (higher profitability, higher expected return). Coverage caveat: many services/financial issuers do not tag GrossProfit at all, so this signal is null for them rather than a derived approximation. recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: asset_growth
signals.rationale: Year-over-year growth of fiscal-year-end total assets (Cooper-Gulen-Schill 2008); direction -1 (high asset growth, low subsequent return, the asset-growth anomaly). Updates once a year at the 10-K filing, matched by fy vs fy-1 rather than a rolling window. recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: accruals
signals.rationale: (Net income - operating cash flow) / average total assets (Sloan 1996); direction -1 (high accruals, low subsequent return -- the earnings-quality/accrual anomaly). Average total assets uses the nearest known value ~365 days earlier (60-day tolerance); null before a full year of history exists rather than a degenerate one-point average. The 2026-09-18 intel brief already flagged accrual/F-Score-style effects as decayed in recent samples -- this card is the local test of that, not an assumption it still works. recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

signals.name: roe
signals.rationale: Net income (trailing annual) / latest known stockholders' equity; direction +1 (quality/profitability premium, Novy-Marx and related quality-factor literature). recent evidence, UCLA (Subrahmanyam) replication through Dec 2024: classic SUE-based PEAD is significant across all stocks (t=2.18) but drops to t=1.43 (not significant) ex-microcap -- per reports/research/intel/I-20260923-07-owner-five-directions-wave.md section 1. Treat any admission here as a microcap-tilted, tier-1/tier-2-scrutinized effect, not a rediscovery of a durable large-cap anomaly.

amendments.reason: sue_eps is forward-filled in the daily panel (2024: 515,244 non-null rows, 464,636 with days_since_report > 5); without the filter the event card would count every forward-filled day with sue_eps >= 2 as a new event (32,332 in 2024 vs 545 true report-day events). The preregistered design already said 'at the report usable session'; this aligns the spec with it.
amendments.timing_caveat: usable session = first NYSE session after the 10-Q/10-K filing date, which usually lags the earnings press release (8-K item 2.02) by days to weeks; the card measures drift after the XBRL filing, the tradeable version with free data
